text:
oncall-bot: 🔔 Pager: high error-rate for customer AcmeCorp (dedicated-pool: eu-west-2-acme-vpc). Alert triggered by 5xx spike on router-proxy and stalled inference tasks. Details: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/1758123456
oncall-bot: severity=high, affected_tenants=acme-corp, impacted_routes=[/v1/generate, /v1/chat], suggested_runbook=dedicated-pool-noisy-tenant.md
alex.sre: I'm on it. Acknowledging pager. Starting triage, grabbing logs and metric windows.
alex.sre: Quick ask — is this a single node flapping or a pool-wide degradation?
incident-bot: New event: 5xx-rate > 8% over 5m for pool eu-west-2-acme-vpc. Autoscaler: not triggered (reserved capacity).
maria.eng: adding recent logs from router-proxy -> sample: `2026-02-10T22:24:12Z ERROR proxy: upstream write failed: io timeout (tenant=acme-42)`
maria.eng: also seeing KV cache thrash on the LRU side, memory pressure on the dedicated q8 nodes. Suspect noisy tenant within the same pool causing eviction storms.
jordan.sre: If it's noisy tenant, we should isolate. Options: (1) temp route acme to fallback idle pool (2) throttle noisy tenant tokens (3) pin acme to ephemeral nodes. Given this is a dedicated contract, avoid cross-tenant from Dedicated to Shared. Recommend routing noisy internal tenant off the pool.
ryan.eng-platform: I can push a temporary routing rule. Command (will create a per-tenant policy):
```
# create routing override
redwoodctl routing create --pool eu-west-2-acme-vpc --tenant noisy-tenant --route-to pool-standby-eu-west-2 --ttl 1h
```
ryan.eng-platform: will prepare the canary; need :thumbsup: from SRE before applying.
alex.sre: +1 apply it. Before that, let's drain the offending node to stop in-flight evictions. Run `redwoodctl node drain node-12` then monitor QPS.
maria.eng: Draining node-12 now. CPU/IPC dropping. KV eviction rates stabilizing in the next 30s.
incident-bot: Action log: node-12 drained by maria.eng at 1758123524. Routing override prepared (pending).
clara.sales: Heads-up: AcmeCorp CSM (amy.custsuccess) is on call with their ops team. They asked for an ETA for resolution and whether this will affect SLAs. They want an exec-level note.
amy.custsuccess: I'm on the bridge with Acme infra; they're seeing timeouts ~200-400 ms additional latency and occasional 502s. They've cut traffic to non-critical flows but want a customer-facing note ASAP. Drafting now.
sam.ops: We should start calculating potential SLA credit exposure once we confirm minutes of downtime/degraded. Who owns the contract calculations? ops or finance?
amy.custsuccess: I'll pull the contract. Baseline: 99.9% uptime SLA for dedicated pools, credits calculated pro-rata. I'll post a draft customer comms for review.
jordan.sre: Routing override applied by ryan.eng-platform at 1758123580. Noisy tenant traffic moved to pool-standby-eu-west-2. Monitoring metrics: 5xx dropped from 9.8% -> 1.1% in 3m.
incident-bot: Metric update: 5xx-rate at 1758123600 = 1.1%. Auto-scaling remained off.
alex.sre: Good. Keep the override for 1 hour, then re-evaluate. I'll continue a focused runbook: run heap snapshot, check KV TTL churn, and verify there are no data-corruption events.
maria.eng: Heap snapshots show a spike in allocation from tenant=acme-42-bot-worker. Looks like a misbehaving batch job. I'll open an internal ticket to the tenant team to throttle job concurrency.
ryan.eng-platform: I'm leaving the routing override in place, TTL extended to 2h to be safe. Logging the rollback plan: `redwoodctl routing delete <override-id>` after validation.
clara.sales: Acme execs want a succinct update for their CTO. Can someone draft an exec summary that I can send? Keep it <5 bullets and include ETA for full mitigation.
amy.custsuccess: Draft customer note (please edit):
"Hi team — we observed elevated error rates in your Dedicated pool due to a noisy workload from an internal tenant. We isolated the traffic and mitigated impact within ~7 minutes; currently service performance is restored. Next steps: completing root cause analysis, targeted throttling of the misbehaving job, and a formal RCA within 48 hours. We will also review SLA credit implications and propose remediation. — Redwood Support"
alex.sre: Small edits to add timings & reference ticket: add timestamps: detection 22:24Z, isolation 22:31Z. Add support ticket ID: INC-2026-ACME-77.
amy.custsuccess: Updated and sent to Acme lead at 22:40Z. They acknowledged :eyes:.
sam.ops: I've started the SLA exposure calc. Preliminary: ~6 minutes of elevated error window affecting 8 rps average leads to X credits — will finalize after final timeline. Marking for finance review.
jordan.sre: We'll own the RCA. Initial hypothesis: noisy batch job causing KV cache eviction storms -> increased upstream timeouts -> router 5xx. Evidence: eviction rate spikes correlated with tenant job windows.
ryan.eng-platform: Note for handoff: I'm transitioning to morning shift at 1758123620. Alex, Jordan, can you pick up continued monitoring and coordinate with platform if we need to re-pin capacity?
alex.sre: I'm taking the next oncall window. Will run a 15-min watch and then handoff doc to evening oncall.
jordan.sre: I'll prepare a short RCA draft and run the checks on persisted metrics. Planning to circulate a first-pass RCA in #postmortems in ~3 hours.
amy.custsuccess: Customer asked about credits. I attached the draft comms and CC'd finance. They want an estimate prior to the exec call tomorrow. Sam, can you have a preliminary number by 09:00 CET?
sam.ops: Yes, will send preliminary calc by 08:45 CET.
maria.eng: Internal action items being created: PLATFORM-4592 (routing override), INFRA-7710 (node drain/playbook), RCA-ACME-1.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitored. Severity downgraded to medium at 1758123660.
clara.sales: Thanks team — I'll relay the exec summary to our AE and the Acme CTO, note that an RCA will follow. Please flag any substantive changes.
alex.sre: Handoff note for evening oncall: keep routing override until confirmed stable for 30m, verify 5xx < 1.5% and latency within SLA P50/P95. If regression detected, rollback override and escalate to platform.
ryan.eng-platform: leaving a link to the runbook + logs: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/1758123456 and the override ID: override-0x7f9c
amy.custsuccess: Customer follow-up: they requested a post-incident call tomorrow 10:00 their local time. I've scheduled and included the Acme ops and CTO.
jordan.sre: One more: include in RCA the bespoke mitigation we applied (routing override) and a recommendation for future: dedicated per-tenant isolation in dedicated pools (configurable hard isolation) to avoid noisy neighbor.
amy.custsuccess: Closing loop — customer satisfied with initial mitigation and timeline for RCA. Will update thread after tomorrow's call.
incident-bot: Incident closed for active mitigation at 1758123720, status -> monitoring-closed.
ryan.eng-platform: leaving final note: consider adding automated per-tenant qps caps to Dedicated pools as a short-term product improvement. Logged as PRODUCT-1024.
clara.sales: Great work everyone.
